title: Devices nearby
subtitle: Send files device-to-device on the same Wi-Fi — no upload, no account.
offline: Couldn't reach the network. Check your connection and reload.
empty: No devices yet. Open this page on another device on the same Wi-Fi.
canceledByPeer: The other device canceled the transfer.
unsupported: Your browser doesn't support nearby transfer. Try Chrome or Edge.
privacyNote: Files go straight between devices, end-to-end encrypted. Nothing touches our servers.
codeIntro: Enter the same code on both devices to connect across any network.
codeWaiting: Waiting for the other device to enter this code…
memoryWarn: This browser holds the file in memory — very large files may fail. Chrome or Edge save straight to disk.
